svg.title: Nursery Reef — A protected shell-bell nursery on living reef shelves
svg.desc: Short shell-canopy paths curl back to a central bell. Two repair supports and a quiet alcove are distinct; bubble perches offer an optional observational loop.
svg.text: A protected shell-bell nursery on living reef shelves
Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 6–10
Short shell-canopy paths curl back to a central bell. Two repair supports and a quiet alcove are distinct;
bubble perches offer an optional observational loop.
